withoutDefaults.description:
Specifies that, when constructing an `Obj`, all fields which have a default value declared and were not provided
a value to the constructor, should be {@link Obj#isFieldUnset unset} (instead of set to the default value).

withMissing.description:
Specifies that, when constructing an `Obj`, all fields which were not provided a value to the constructor, should
be {@link Obj#isFieldMissing missing} (instead of unset, or set to the default value). If set to true, setting
{@link withoutDefaults} to true has no effect.

doNotConvert.description:
If `true`, do not attempt to convert the field values provided to Obj#make. This is a performance optimization when
field values are already in the correct type. However, should be used with caution, as it can lead to unexpected
behavior if the field values are not in the correct type.

@see FieldType#convertValue
